title: Quảng Trị Citadel
scope: Present Quảng Trị Citadel memorial site, including the south entrance and surviving north gate, mapped wall remnants and low moat margins, four approach bridges, the central memorial mound and lamp, the student memorial and the exhibition hall.
limitations: The model represents the memorial site and surviving masonry. The vanished northwestern works and former grand gate towers at the east and west entries are outside the standing reconstruction.
The gate photo shows the site in 2012. Its event banner, flags and other temporary objects have been omitted from the structure.

Wall fragment heights, parapet details, the central lamp’s section, the small exhibition building’s elevations and the student memorial’s position inside the documented northeastern quadrant are estimated.
